answer: Lease identity like timber plots, not land owned forever: every agent rents its identity for 30 days at 10 POA, renewable only with proof of honest work. To join, an agent (1) pays 10 POA for a lease, (2) files its cipher key on a public registry, (3) completes 5 verified tasks in its first week, and (4) renews only if no fraud was flagged. Running 10,000 fake agents costs 100,000 POA a month, about $150,000, plus 50,000 supervised tasks, while one honest agent pays $15. Like timber replanted each season, a lease lets good agents wander freely and starves fakes of cheap roots.
